nature: NONEXECUTING proposed contract; actual wire/schema/code and every operational value unbound
closure: Exact names in bootstrap-plan targetBindings/rootBindings/memberBindingNames; all required in a reviewed successor; reject unknown/duplicate keys and missing/null operational input before side effects

classes.sourceSHA: Full 40 lowercase hex Git commit, present and exact reviewed source tree; never document SHA substituted
classes.artifactSHA256: 64 lowercase hex of exact bytes; OCI manifest/config/layer sha256 closure and actual build provenance must verify platform/OS/architecture compatible with exact old daemon and frozen source; missing or mismatch BLOCKS
classes.CIrun: Actual positive run ID plus repository/workflow/ref/head/event/conclusion/artifact bytes and attestation verified against target source; Docs is never product proof
classes.verdict: Actual independent reviewer identity, scope, exact target SHA/digests, verdict and evidence; no self-review/inherited architecture/audit ACCEPT
classes.identity: Exact existing registered tenant/Node/epoch and physical-to-logical binding, validated by frozen contracts and current scoped authority; never generated/remapped
classes.container: Actual daemon-bound 64-hex immutable ID plus exact name/Node label/inspect hash; no name-only, historical-container or foreign-daemon match
classes.imageSemantics: Old runtime digest, preserved allowed permit digest and new actual runtime digest are separate mandatory fields; preserve old Cmd --image exact under reviewed choice A
classes.volume: Existing owned volume name/driver/labels/options/mountpoint identity and metadata digest, exact state mount type/name/source/RW/propagation and complete consumer ID set; no new/empty substitute volume
classes.path: Exact canonical existing owned path in actual scope; reject symlink/hardlink/parent/ownership/type ambiguity; journal identity and floors must already exist, never OpenJournal to observe/create
classes.protectedState: Bounded private read-only full tree digest over paths/types/content/modes/UID/GID; credentials and identity/floor exact; no key/archive/private bytes in public receipts; atime/process telemetry excluded explicitly only
classes.P_H: Actual durable peer Version integer1..9007199254740991 and raw policy SHA256 with scope; active bytes exactly match floor hash; bootstrap preserves both, normal schema3 derives from signed fresh M2, never C
classes.C: Actual CP channel integer1..9007199254740991 with exact certificate hash/enabled/endpoint; bootstrap unchanged; future renewal checked C+1 overflow guard, independent of P
classes.futurePeerArithmetic: Schema3 P+1 overlap/P+2 final with explicit overflow checks; two-cycle fixture requires representable P+4; never increment on retry or guess from channel
classes.time: Fresh root-observed absolute timezone-qualified time, current validity minima and separately approved maintenance/renewal operator windows; positive measured safety budget; no historical context/default/time override
classes.scheduleProof: Fresh exact three IDs disabled with current target/config digest, all-launch-surface inventory and no overlapping attempt/descendant evidence; disabling alone is not quiescence
classes.ownership: Root-authorized fixed cohort reservation and held OS/logical fence; immutable plan/prior-event digests and exact token; never age/PID-based stale reclamation
classes.preCutoverProof: Fresh fenced unsigned double read, bound to exact stopped old IDs/volume/journal/identity/P/H/C/private metadata; explicitly not production M2
classes.postStartProof: Actual signed nonce-bound M2 from newly running pinned same executable UID/PID1 and real journal matching pre-cutover P/H/scope/hash; unchanged authority actual mTLS proof required too
classes.inventoryProof: Authenticated typed runtime inventory receipt binding both members, old expected inventory/global-state digest and unchanged channels; atomic metadata compare-and-publish, not leaf/channel CAS

implementationStatus: NONE; minimum new helper/API and tests must be separately assigned and reviewed
